ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Dominantly low-intensity black/dark-grey pixels with approximately 15% high-intensity white pixel coverage in the form of scattered points.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous dark field across 90% of visible surface; high-frequency white point-like blobs concentrated in the lower-central region and radiating toward the distal lobe tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch with a calculated pixel angle of approximately 40 degrees and a deep vertical bounding-box recession.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serration pattern along distal margins; pixel-amplitude variations of 5-10 pixels forming irregular peaks and valleys, particularly on the outer lobe segments.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Bilateral convex curve along the upper trailing edge, tapering to sharp, slightly upward-curved tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized high-contrast white clusters detected at the far-left and far-right tips, consistent with calcified pixel structures (barnacle colonization).

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Physical protrusion and white calcified accumulation visible on the leftmost fluke tip; several white impact-style scars across the central ventral surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique 'splatter' pattern of white micro-dots across the dark ventral pigmentation, concentrated near the peduncle attachment point.
